source: BEAM (frozen blind test run of Nov 7, 2026: the half of the model that never trained on this year; the day was sealed until then), radar NOAA MRMS, lightning NOAA GOES GLM
note: A recorded storm chosen for what happened on the ground (2.5-inch hail and 4 injuries near Wallowa, on the public record), not for how BEAM did: an example, not a measure of accuracy.
story: Hail 2.5 inches across and 4 injuries are on the public record for this storm near Wallowa (NWS storm reports; NOAA Storm Events, event 1053548). An NWS Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued at 3:21 PM covered the town of Wallowa, but not most of the Bear Creek drainage.
